provenance: Real NIH ChestX-ray14 radiographs from the official test split, which this model was scored on and never trained on: 16 films, four for each class (Effusion or not, as NIH's labels mined from the reports say) and each view (AP or PA), drawn once from distinct patients among well-exposed films; the draw reads no model output. NIH Clinical Center, ChestX-ray14, https://nihcc.app.box.com/v/ChestXray-NIHCC. Wang X, Peng Y, Lu L, Lu Z, Bagheri M, Summers RM. ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases. CVPR 2017. The data is provided by the NIH Clinical Center.
split: the official ChestX-ray14 test split, 16 films, four for each class and view
licence: NIH ChestX-ray14 terms; no restrictions on use, attribution requested
attribution: NIH Clinical Center, ChestX-ray14, https://nihcc.app.box.com/v/ChestXray-NIHCC. Wang X, Peng Y, Lu L, Lu Z, Bagheri M, Summers RM. ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases. CVPR 2017. The data is provided by the NIH Clinical Center.
modifications: each 1024 px PNG converted to grey and resized to 224 x 224 with Pillow's bilinear filter, stored as uint8 values

input.layout: samples[i] is a flat row-major 224*224 uint8 image, values 0-255

expected.note: Measured here with onnxruntime on exactly these 16 films at the published operating point (validation sensitivity 0.80). Sixteen films show the model running, not how well it ranks: the card's AUROC is over 25,589.

per_row.margin_is: p(class 1) minus the decision threshold; class 1 at or above 0
per_row.note: Each row's class by the page's rule and its margin to the decision boundary, from this file's samples, preprocessing and graph with onnxruntime; the page compares every row, and a different class within the tolerance of the boundary is a near tie, reported rather than failed.
